name: Jan de Vries
bio:
Jan de Vries spent his early career in law enforcement, specializing in risk assessment and security protocols before transitioning to motorsport. A lifelong racing enthusiast, Jan saw an opportunity to combine his professional skills with his passion. He began consulting for smaller racing teams, providing comprehensive security plans that prioritized the safety of personnel and equipment.

Jan's meticulous approach to security is well-regarded. He's known for his thoroughness and ability to anticipate potential threats. While he isn't always the most outgoing member of the team, his dedication to protecting the team's assets is unwavering. His experience has taught him to trust his gut, often leading to proactive measures that prevent problems before they arise.

Now at the Junior Kart Team, Jan has built a security presence and culture that is second to none. From securing the kart garage to ensuring the safety of drivers and crew at the track, Jan is the team's silent guardian. His commitment to excellence and unwavering loyalty make him an invaluable asset.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Jan is a solidly built man with a watchful gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook and pen.
Insists on conducting a daily security check at precisely 7:00 AM, regardless of the schedule.
Rarely smiles, but offers a curt nod of approval when things are running smoothly.
